title: Senior Navy sources say the greys' genetic collection has ended

tellings.quote: But, I've heard from some pretty senior, you know, impressive people in uh the Navy that like that might be real and like that that uh genetic collection on the part of these grays just ended.

plain: The greys, the small grey-skinned beings described in many abduction stories, have stopped collecting human genetic material, according to people Michels says he has heard from. Michels says this himself, in a conversation with Matthew Pines, and puts it down to "pretty senior" and "impressive" people in the Navy whom he does not name. He says they told him the abductions "might be real" and that this genetic collection "just ended".
